final_message: Applied grade findings F001-F012 to cnd-specdojo: added the deployment baseline (what runs where and what is not deployed) and the approval scope, separating the scope submitted for approval from reservation A (site viewing auth/delivery, until operations design) and reservation B (REL-10, PJR-CJMN), each with permitted and held follow-up work. The 2026-11-15 human PO decisions are preserved. Also added normal-success and repository-failure verification expectations, BA/OPS confirmers, issue/risk/decision classification with PJR destinations and judgment timing, links to cpd-specdojo-cli, ifd-specdojo and ifx-cmd-ai-provider-cli, a schema reference for REL-05, and a maintenance handoff. Recorded the decisions in the ticket's response section. status stays draft.
handoff: `grade run --target deliverable` has not been re-run; it launches a real agent CLI and is outside the executor stage. Re-grade cnd-specdojo after this run (ticket completion condition).

The tracking PJR for reservation A (site viewing auth and delivery) could not be found in the declared inputs, so the document says 'PJR は未登録'. ARC should report it to PM for registration and then record the destination in the future-work table.
DC-002 is explicitly recorded as unmet until the human PO decides on the deployment baseline at T-KATA-WAVE-1 140.

The site build owner is written as current behavior from implementation evidence: VitePress build is not launched from a CLI command. Build environment and delivery destination remain under reservation A.
Repository failure recovery expectations (REL-05/REL-06) were not specified for lack of grounds; they are recorded as a risk in future work.
